faqs.q: Do I need a credit card to start?
faqs.a: No. The Catechist Free plan is free forever — just create your account and start using it.

faqs.q: Is my data safe? Does the platform comply with data protection laws?
faqs.a: Yes. Catequese Viva was designed with data protection from the start. Consents are digitally recorded and you can request data export or deletion at any time.

faqs.q: Can I import catechumens I already have in a spreadsheet?
faqs.a: Yes. The platform accepts batch import via CSV file. Just upload your spreadsheet with name, surname and birth date.

faqs.q: Does it work on mobile? Do I need to install an app?
faqs.a: It works perfectly in the mobile browser, no installation needed. The interface is adapted for mobile devices.

faqs.q: Can I have multiple parishes under one account?
faqs.a: Yes. The Diocese plan allows managing multiple parishes with consolidated analytics.

faqs.q: What kind of support do you offer?
faqs.a: All plans have community support. Paid plans have priority support.
